name: model-aware-reference-reconstruction
applicability: Resolve the same platform-neutral visual facts for every supported image type before applying a target adapter.

required_fields_when_applicable: relative position, direction, contact, containment, and occlusion
lighting, value structure, and per-region color relationships

priority_model.P0_identity: Facts whose change breaks subject identity or the visual skeleton.
priority_model.P1_similarity: Facts whose change materially reduces similarity.
priority_model.P2_flexible: Facts that may vary without compromising the reconstruction.

canonical_visual_spec_contract.evidence_boundary: Record visible facts and conservative inferences only; do not infer original model settings, hidden parameters, or creator intent.

required_architecture: The visual fact source is platform-neutral and complete for the current image rather than a fixed scene schema.
Prompt compilation resolves a profile by platform, optional model, optional version, and task type; unknown target details use a conservative platform default.
Platform adapters may change ordering, redundancy, syntax, supported parameters, and evidence-scoped compensation, but may not change canonical facts.
Observed platform drift is handled in the relevant adapter rather than becoming a universal image fact.
Validation separately checks shared visual invariants and platform-specific compilation rules.

gpt: Use complete natural-language instructions and explicit spatial, structural, color, and occlusion relationships.
Keep critical constraints beside the affected object or region.
Apply compensation only when the current source or comparison evidence supports the observed drift.
grok: Use compact direct instructions while retaining all required structural zones and depth layers.
Restate P0 relationships without inventing platform parameters.
Keep distinct regions separate when simplification would merge geometry, material, or color.
midjourney: Front-load framing, complete silhouette, subject scale, crop, and P0 geometry before high-salience local detail.
Describe local details through their role, location, attachment, and occlusion so they remain subordinate to the whole.
Append only source-derived aspect ratio, conservative style control, and directly relevant negative constraints unless the user requests more.

pass_criteria: All platform prompts preserve every P0 identity fact and all applicable P1 facts from the current image.
The three adapters differ materially in instruction structure without changing shared facts.
No adapter promotes P2 detail above P0 composition or geometry.
No model, version, seed, or hidden generation parameter is inferred from the source.
No adapter or regression rule contains a private-image-specific scene, object, palette, garment, or composition.
